# NHL Power Ranking — RagLab Sports

> NHL power rankings, head-to-head game projections, market edges, and season simulations from the RagLab power model, exposed to AI clients through a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP).

The live site ranks all 32 NHL teams and publishes the same model over the Model Context Protocol. This repository is its public, MIT-licensed documentation mirror: https://github.com/raglab-ca/sports. Complete context lives in [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/raglab-ca/sports/blob/main/llms-full.txt).

- Site: https://sports.raglab.services
- MCP endpoint: https://sports.raglab.services/mcp (POST, Streamable HTTP; bearer API key)
- Server: nhl-power-ranking v2.1.0 · contract schema v1.0.0 · 47 tools
- Agent card: https://sports.raglab.services/.well-known/agent-card.json (mirror: https://github.com/raglab-ca/sports/blob/main/agent-card.json)
- Full context: https://github.com/raglab-ca/sports/blob/main/llms-full.txt
- Repository: https://github.com/raglab-ca/sports

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sports.raglab.services/): top 5 power teams, top players by impact, official standings, tonight's games, yesterday's results, and the latest headlines.
- [Power rankings](https://sports.raglab.services/rankings/nhl): all 32 teams by model score with day, week, and month movement.
- [NHL vs standings divergence](https://sports.raglab.services/rankings/nhl-vs-standings): where the model disagrees with the record.
- [Playoff probabilities](https://sports.raglab.services/playoffs/probabilities): projected standings and qualification odds.
- [Schedule strength](https://sports.raglab.services/schedule-strength): remaining opponent difficulty, toughest first.
- [Team pages](https://sports.raglab.services/teams): one page per NHL team under /teams/{slug}.
- [Game analytics](https://sports.raglab.services/games): one page per stored game under /games/{date}/{away}-vs-{home}.
- [Developer documentation](https://sports.raglab.services/developers): API keys, client setup, and the interactive tool reference.

## MCP tools (47)

### Power model

Power metrics, history, cohort, similarity, and outlier analysis

- `get_power_rankings` — All 32 NHL teams ranked by the site's power model with score, 1-day/7-day/30-day score and rank changes, and the snapshot date.
- `get_team_power_breakdown` — Metric-by-metric breakdown behind one team's power score, including sections, weights, contributions, raw values, normalized scores, league ranks, differentials, and real/proxy/no-data status.
- `get_metric_league` — League-wide table for one power metric built from the latest stored team breakdowns: every team's raw value, formatted display, normalized score, league rank and section, best first, with the league average and top/bottom rows.
- `get_power_matrix` — One aligned power snapshot for all or selected teams. Returns rank, score, section scores, effective weights and contributions, and optionally every selected metric's raw value, normalized score, league rank, status, unit, and delta inputs.
- `compare_cohorts` — Compares two to six team cohorts across selected model scores or oriented raw metrics, with weighted differences, section drivers, coverage, overlap handling, and descriptive caveats.
- `find_similar_teams` — Finds teams with the closest selected power-profile values to a target team, using deterministic weighted distance, coverage, section drivers, and metric drivers.
- `find_metric_outliers` — Finds unusual team-metric values using oriented raw values or model scores with robust MAD/IQR/sample-SD fallback statistics and deterministic result ordering.
- `get_power_history` — Paginated daily power-score and rank history for one team from stored snapshots.
- `get_metric_history` — Paginated raw and normalized history for one validated power metric key.
- `get_section_history` — Paginated score, effective weight, contribution, factor, and league-range history for one power-model section.
- `explain_power_change` — Compares the latest stored breakdown on or before two dates and decomposes the total, rank, section, and metric changes. The decomposition is descriptive, not causal proof.

### Players & value

Player dossiers, salary and contract value, and Power Above Average

- `get_player_profile` — Full dossier for one player: identity and bio, viewed-season line, prior NHL seasons, salary cap hit, contract value (PPV), injury status, and the stored Power Above Average row with its ledger.
- `get_team_paa` — One team's stored Power Above Average rows for a season: a ranked contributors ladder (best or worst first), a complete available-value lookup by player id, and every unscored player with the model's reason.
- `get_paa_leaders` — League-wide Power Above Average leaders for a season, ranked best (order=desc) or worst (order=asc), with pagination.

### Teams

Season games, metric and projection histories, and schedule strength

- `get_team_games` — One team's season game list (oldest first) with final state, opponent context, the stored post-game power score/rank and per-game deltas, plus the team's remaining-schedule strength.
- `get_team_metrics` — One team's per-metric and per-section score/raw history aligned to its games (oldest first, index-parallel), optionally filtered to selected metric and section keys.
- `get_team_projections` — One team's projected final standing and playoff odds per stored simulation (one row per date, oldest first).
- `get_schedule_strength` — Remaining-schedule strength for all teams, toughest first: games left, opponents counted, and the average current power score of those opponents.

### Games & markets

Projections, scenarios, official evidence, impacts, and market history

- `get_games` — Stored game cards for one date: final or projected score, status, model win probabilities/odds, and sportsbook moneylines when available.
- `get_game_analysis` — Stored head-to-head analysis for one game: probabilities, scores, overtime split, model versus market odds, matchup edges, the fair-price scoreline ladder with risk tiers, and available pregame availability context. Set includeCategories=false for the lean payload without section category edges and metric-by-metric matchups.
- `project_matchup` — Runs the head-to-head engine for any two teams, scheduled or not, with expected and projected score, win probabilities, overtime split, and metric-by-metric adjusted matchups. Win probabilities come from a sequential 12x5-minute situational ensemble over the H2H base rates.
- `project_scenario` — Simulates a baseline and an explicit counterfactual with the event engine (12x5min + OT + shootout). Scenario inputs are per-team capacity multipliers (offense, defense, goaltending, discipline, physicality, shootout, pace), a home-ice factor, and back-to-back goalie selection. Returns simulator reports, numeric diffs and the resolved overrides.
- `find_value_bets` — Paginated scan of stored game projections against sportsbook moneylines, ranked by expected value with no-vig probability, edge, price, bookmaker, and adjustment status.
- `get_game_impact` — For a final game, compares the stored pre-game and post-game snapshots for both teams and reports score/rank change plus section and metric-level decomposition.
- `get_market_history` — Returns locally sampled two-sided NHL moneyline revisions for one game, optionally filtered by bookmaker and UTC date range, with provider update time, local observation time, coverage, and a clearly labeled legacy card fallback.
- `get_game_evidence` — Fetches official NHL landing, box-score, and play-by-play evidence for one game; normalizes events with stable IDs, filters and paginates chronologically, and reports component-level coverage and finality.

### Live & pregame

Live game state, situation model, commentary, live edges, and pregame availability

- `get_live_game` — Current live (or final) game state from the NHL feed: score, period, clock, shots, and the player box score with goalie lines when available. Set includeMetrics=true to also recompute the in-game matchup metrics from this game's play-by-play.
- `get_game_situation` — Runs the live situation engine for an in-progress game: active situations (score/time A-J plus game-style Grind/Open game/Desperate push), manpower and momentum overlays (PP/PP2/PK/EN/4v4/MOM), the completed and in-progress game situation intervals, win/regulation/OT/shootout/next-goal/comeback probabilities, the resumed 12-segment ensemble, in-game metric factors, and the live model-vs-market edge.
- `get_live_edge` — Current live win probabilities scored against the stored market moneylines for an in-progress game, using the same fair-price and risk-tier rules as the pregame ladder. Market prices do not update in-game, so quote age is expected to be large and the result is provisional.
- `get_game_commentary` — Narrates the live situation portrait with the configured LLM: a one-sentence teaser and a full read, grounded strictly in the situation model's numbers. Cached per material state change.
- `get_pregame_availability` — Fetches the free pregame feeds for one game: announced starting goalies, injuries with top-6/top-4/line impact, projected line combinations, and the metric overrides those absences imply. Set includeLines=false to skip the line-combination scrape.

### Standings

Official tables, power standings, and the projected playoff picture

- `get_official_standings` — Official NHL standings for a season: league table plus conference and division groupings, with wins, losses, OT losses, points, points percentage, goal differential, streaks and clinch indicators.
- `get_power_standings` — The league table ordered by the power model: each team's stored power score, official points and rank, grouped into conferences and divisions with playoff-odds context when available.
- `get_playoff_bracket` — The resolved playoff bracket for a season: seeds, first three rounds, the Final and the champion. Real backfilled results take precedence once complete; otherwise the bracket is the stored playoff ensemble projection.
- `get_playoff_picture` — Playoff seeds by conference from the latest stored season simulation: top 3 per division plus 2 wildcards, each with projected final points, plus the first team out and the projected cut line. Use list_simulations to inspect a specific run.

### Simulations

Stored season simulations, game by game

- `list_simulations` — Paginated stored season simulations, newest first, with as-of date, status, labels, and projected game count.
- `get_simulation` — One stored simulation with every team's projected remaining and projected final record.
- `get_simulation_games` — Paginated game-by-game results from one stored simulation, optionally filtered by team and inclusive date range.
- `get_projected_standings` — Projected final league, conference, and division standings from one stored simulation.

### NHL data

Base data ingested from the official NHL APIs

- `list_teams` — All teams for a season with identity, conference, division, logo, and current record.
- `get_team_stats` — Official NHL season reports and player lines for one team. Team reports can be disabled when only player or record fields are needed.
- `get_team_roster` — Current club roster merged with target-season skater and goalie lines, player bios, and persisted injury status.
- `get_schedule` — Paginated preseason/regular-season schedule with UTC start times, prior/next games, rest days and hours, back-to-back flags, surrounding opponents, and opponent power rank/score.

### News

Aggregated NHL headlines by team and player

- `get_news` — Stored NHL headlines from the aggregated public feeds, newest first, optionally narrowed to one team or player. Each item carries the teams and players it was linked to at ingest.

### Reference

Algorithm definitions and season metadata

- `get_metric_definitions` — Complete versioned definitions for all 81 power metrics, including exact formula, unit, source, window, cadence, direction, sample guidance, missing-value behavior, proxy caveats, weights, normalization, aggregation, and opponent adjustment.
- `get_model_manifest` — Machine-readable manifest for the current power model version: all 81 metric definitions, section and subsection weights, normalization, aggregation, fixed-point opponent adjustment, dynamic overtime reweighting, and model warnings.
- `get_seasons` — Seasons the system holds data for, with the current season id. Use a season id with any other tool to analyze a past season.

## MCP prompts (7)

- `analyze-matchup` — Guided head-to-head analysis of two teams using the power model and h2h engine.
- `find-value-bets` — Scan upcoming games for model-market disagreements and explain the strongest opportunities.
- `team-deep-dive` — Full research report on one team's power, drivers, trend, roster, schedule, and outlook.
- `discover-team-archetypes` — Compare cohorts and find similar or unusual teams from the current power snapshot.
- `player-deep-dive` — Full research report on one player's value, role, trend, and contract context.
- `live-game-brief` — Situation-aware brief for an in-progress game: state, probabilities, edges, and commentary.
- `counterfactual-matchup` — Compare a baseline H2H projection with explicit scenario assumptions.

## MCP resources (3)

- `power-ranking://docs/metrics` — Version 1.7.0 manifest with every metric formula, source, weight, window, caveat, and model behavior.
- `power-ranking://docs/glossary` — Freshness, identifiers, model methodology and value-bet math.
- `power-ranking://docs/tools` — Every tool this server exposes, grouped by domain.

## Data notes

- Seasons are 8-digit ids (20252026 = the 2025-26 season); omit the season argument for the current one.
- Team codes are official NHL tri-codes (TOR, MTL, NYR); call `list_teams` to resolve or verify them.
- Every successful tool returns the same envelope: `schemaVersion`, `data`, `meta`, and `evidence`. Check `meta.asOf`, `meta.completeness`, and `meta.warnings` before relying on a result.
- Power scores, normalized metric scores, and PAA are snapshot-relative and descriptive, not calibrated win probabilities.
- The MCP endpoint requires an API key (Pro plan): send `Authorization: Bearer pr_live_...`.
